audit.whatIsWrong: diff HARD at 8/10 with breakdown.difficulty and report[14] both quoting 36.88%. The packet says 47.72% over 285 games.
audit.why: 47.72% is a losing lane, but it is a near-even one — an 8/10 with a 36.88% figure tells the player the matchup is close to unplayable when it is not.
audit.corrected: diff TRICKY at 6/10, tone recoloured, both percentages restated at 47.72%. This is still the worst win rate in my slice and the rating reflects that.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[4] puts Riven's R spike at level 5. Blade of the Exile is her ultimate and that row's label is Level 6.
audit.why: It moves her strongest window a level earlier than it exists.
audit.corrected: whys[4] now reads 'At 6'. The chart matches the packet in both layers, so no flips were needed.

audit.whatIsWrong: focus.text, breakdown.cooldowns and report[5] all treat the third cast of Broken Wings as the stun and call it 'the only hard CC in her kit'. Riven's stun is Ki Burst (W), on 11/10/9/8/7; the third Broken Wings knocks back. Nothing in the content layer said Ki Burst cancels Meditate.
audit.why: The page tells you to track the wrong ability. You can eat two Broken Wings and be fine; you cannot eat the W, and the W is also what ends your channel — so it is the cooldown the whole lane is played around.
audit.corrected: Ki Burst named as the stun with its 11s rank-1 cooldown and 260 range, the third Q restated as a knockback, and the Meditate cancel written into whys[1] and the cooldown breakdown.
sources: enemyKit W Ki Burst (hardCC, cd 11/10/9/8/7, range 260)
enemyKit Q 'the third hit knocking back nearby enemies'

edits.before: Her third Q (Broken Wings) — the AOE knockup/stun that lands her entire Q-W-E burst on you. Bait the first two dashes, step back, and only walk up once that third charge is spent; getting stunned by it is what turns every trade into a death.
edits.after: Ki Burst (W) — the stun, 11s at rank 1, that lands her entire Q-W-E burst and cancels Meditate mid-channel. Bait Broken Wings' first two dashes, step outside its 260 range, and only walk up once her W is spent; that stun is what turns a trade into a death.

edits.before: Track her third Q (the AOE stun) above everything — it's the only hard CC in her kit and it's what lands her full combo on you. Her Q stacks decay if she stops dashing, so bait the first two charges and step back before the third; once it's spent she has roughly 4 seconds of zero lockdown to walk up in.
edits.after: Track Ki Burst (W) above everything — it is the only stun in her kit, 11s at rank 1, and it is what lands her full combo and cancels your Meditate. The third Broken Wings knocks back rather than stuns, so bait the first two charges, step out before it, and walk up while both are down.

edits.before: Alpha Strike's untargetable frames can dodge Riven's third-Q stun and her W if you blink as she winds up — this is your single most important interaction, since the stun is what lands her full burst. Wuju Style's true damage ignores the armor in her bruiser build, and Highlander's slow immunity beats her E-dash chase. Note Meditate's channel roots you and is free combo bait for her — don't use it in range.
edits.after: Alpha Strike's untargetable frames can dodge Ki Burst (W) if you blink as she winds up — your single most important interaction, since that stun is what lands her full burst; her third Broken Wings knocks back rather than stunning. Wuju Style's true damage ignores the armor in her bruiser build, and Highlander's slow immunity beats her E-dash chase. Meditate's channel is free combo bait — never use it in her range.

edits.before: Her Ki Burst (W) stun comes online at level 2 for guaranteed trades.
edits.after: Ki Burst (W) arrives at 2 and its stun cancels your Meditate channel.

edits.before: At level 5 her R spike keeps her kill pressure over yours.
edits.after: At 6 Blade of the Exile keeps her kill pressure over yours.

edits.before: Level 5 and her level 6 Blade of the Exile (R) keep her ahead - the R AD boost and Wind Slash execute mean she can still burst you down. Your job is to reach 6 with Highlander (R) and start dodging her Ki Burst (W) stun so trades stop being one-sided.
edits.after: Level 5 and her level 6 Blade of the Exile (R) keep her ahead - the AD boost and a single Wind Slash mean she can still burst you down. Your job is to reach 6 with Highlander (R) and hold Alpha Strike for her Ki Burst (W), which is 11s at rank 1.

edits.before: It's an 8/10 because Riven has everything that beats Yi — point-and-click-adjacent burst, a hard stun to catch you after Alpha Strike, mobility to chase, and a kit that's strongest exactly when yours is weakest. The 36.88% win rate is real: you lose the lane by default and have to win the game in spite of it.
edits.after: It's a 6/10 because Riven has everything that beats Yi — burst on demand, a Ki Burst stun to catch you after Alpha Strike, mobility to chase, and a kit strongest exactly when yours is weakest. At 47.72% you do lose this lane more often than not, and then you win the game in spite of it.

edits.before: HARD (36.88% WR, 8/10 difficulty) — you lose this lane by default to Riven's burst and stun; survive to 2+ items and win the game instead of the matchup.
edits.after: TRICKY (47.72% WR, 6/10) — you lose this lane more often than not to Riven's burst and stun; survive to 2+ items and win the game instead of the matchup.
